# Palette attribution and adaptation notes

## Nord

Original palette: https://www.nordtheme.com/docs/colors-and-palettes/

Polar Night neutrals are used for Light-mode links and buttons so small text stays readable; Frost remains the brand and player accent. Dark links use a slightly lighter Frost derivative (#9bcbd8) to stay readable on selection tint; separators use a neutral derivative.

## Solarized

Original palette: https://ethanschoonover.com/solarized/

Light blue links/buttons use a darker derivative (#1c6a9f) for small-text contrast. Dark links use a brighter cyan derivative (#38b4ab). Secondary text uses stronger neutrals (#52676d in Light) than low-contrast syntax comments; separators and hover colours are small derivatives.

## Gruvbox

Original palette: https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox

Secondary text uses stronger palette neutrals. The Light button hover (#923203) is a darker orange derivative; dark hover (#fea04b) is a lighter derivative. Light links use a darker orange derivative (#9d3503) on selection tint. Selection uses warm neutral surfaces rather than orange text backgrounds.

## Catppuccin

Original palette: https://catppuccin.com/palette/

Latte uses Subtext 1 rather than weaker secondary colours. Light selection is a pale mauve tint (#e5ddf1), with dark active navigation #313244. Links and hover colours use small mauve derivatives (#7330cb in Light; #d5b8f9 in Dark) for contrast on selected rows.

## Rosé Pine

Original palette: https://rosepinetheme.com/palette/

Dawn secondary text (#68637e) is a darker derivative of Subtle. Small Dawn links use Pine; rose remains a decorative accent. Dark secondary text uses brighter derivatives of Subtle (#aaa5c2), rather than low-contrast Muted; separators, hover and shell secondary colours are adjusted. Focus uses Iris.
